description: This is a shell script used for testing Git branch behavior, specifically interpreting exotic branch name arguments such as '@{-1}', '@{upstream}', and other special syntax. It sets up repositories, creates branches, tests updating and deleting branches with special references, and verifies expected outcomes.

methods.name: expect_branch
methods.description: Verifies that a specific branch points to the expected commit message.

methods.name: expect_deleted
methods.description: Ensures a branch or reference has been successfully deleted.
